description: Installation of Automated Passenger Clearance Gates at the Departure Terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Cooperation Agreement entered into between the International Organization for Migration and the Government of Japan, improvement activities of facilities of the Bandaranaike International Airport in Sri Lanka have been commenced from the year 2023 in accordance with international practices under the project of ‘Preparation for the Control of Border-related Infectious Diseases in South-Western Asian Countries’ with the assistance of Japanese Yen 1,170 million. Under this, the installation of 04 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates at the arrival terminal of the Airport has been completed, and it has been scheduled to commence passenger clearance activities through those gates in the near future. By installing 04 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates at the departure terminal in parallel with the 04 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates installed at the arrival terminal, it is possible to carry out passenger clearance activities more efficiently and effectively according to a single methodology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to install 04 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates at the departure terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport in the year 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.
